rule: An exception identifies evidence that an expression satisfies an existing presentation rule despite the guard's limitation. It cannot introduce another permitted source or presentation form.
scope: An exception for a preformatted style is allowed only where the text drawn there is the App's own literal; a site that draws a supplied value is not an exception, it is a site to fix.
limit: What this is: a regression aid. It detects the forms its tests exercise, listed in tests/support/presentation-guard.mjs. What it is not: a boundary, a proof, or mechanically complete coverage. A later unit that needs complete coverage must establish that itself; it cannot inherit it from this guard or this list.
